svg.title: 31 Bloom filter bits
svg.desc: A 16-bit Bloom filter with two probes per key sets bits 8, 11, 1 and 3 for apple and pear. kiwi reads bits 8 and 7 and bit 7 is clear, a definite miss; plum reads bits 1 and 11, both set, a false positive.
svg.text: Bit 7 is 0, so kiwi was never added
Both are 1, yet plum was never added
pear set bit 1 and apple set bit 11
One clear bit proves absence; all-set
